question: Should OpenClaw add task-level model metadata to HEARTBEAT.md, or should heartbeat task routing be handled through a broader per-turn/plugin model-routing contract?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the safe implementation depends on maintainer intent for public syntax, task batching versus split turns, and how model overrides compose with provider auth, fallbacks, and session state.

options.title: Design shared routing contract first
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable heartbeat or per-turn routing contract before accepting HEARTBEAT.md-only syntax.

options.title: Add heartbeat-only task metadata
options.body: Implement a narrow HEARTBEAT.md task model field with explicit split/group semantics and compatibility tests.

options.title: Keep routing plugin-owned
options.body: Decline core task syntax and document whole-turn before_model_resolve plugins as the supported routing path, accepting that multiple due heartbeat tasks cannot be independently routed today.

recommendation.title: Design shared routing contract first
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide a reusable heartbeat or per-turn routing contract before accepting HEARTBEAT.md-only syntax.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history across the model hook seam, task-batching commit path, and product-boundary decision needed here.
